name: Ownership-Preserving Generic Recursive Relational Lift Theorem
purpose: Replace repeated brute-force O-level closure censuses by a generic conditional theorem plus cheap premise verification and optional regression sentinels.

carrier.parent: finite exact carrier H_n with multiplicity-aware quotient q_n and admitted labelled Counter transition c_n
carrier.lift: finite nontrivial connected component of distinct H_n owner occurrences joined by pairwise typed outer relations
carrier.quotient: q_(n+1)(X) = anonymous finite bag of owner q_n states after all retained reservations through scope n+1

hypotheses.H1: Parent O_n is certified in the same frozen multiplicity-aware resource observer and c_n factors through q_n.
hypotheses.H2: Parent occurrences are finite and anonymous up to hierarchical isomorphism; equality of q_n transports occurrence multiplicity.
hypotheses.H3: Lift states are finite nontrivial connected components of distinct O_n owners with pairwise typed outer incidences.
hypotheses.H4: Every new outer relation joins two distinct owners and consumes exactly one compatible typed endpoint on each side.
hypotheses.H5: Retained site state is exact sitewise (p,f), with every reservation reflected in f.
hypotheses.H6: Inherited rank-lift acts inside one owner, preserves ownership, and factors through q_n.
hypotheses.H7: Inherited relation-add acts at its declared parent scope and factors through q_n.
hypotheses.H8: Outer relation-add legality reads only distinct ownership, typed p/f, frozen Bridge, scope labels, and multiplicity.
hypotheses.H9: Admitted writes change only q-visible ownership/resource data; no admitted action reads hidden topology, T, ancestry, provenance, or topology-derived roles.
hypotheses.H10: Relations are monotone and pairwise: no deletion, rewiring, retagging, endpoint replacement, copying, multiway junction, or feedback.
hypotheses.H11: Alternatives use frozen Counter semantics and labels contain no hidden exact representative identity.
hypotheses.H12: Hierarchical relabelling is equivariant; canonicalisation is representative-independent.
hypotheses.H13: Ordinary one-cross same-level composition merges inputs into one connected O_(n+1); O_(n+2) starts only when complete O_(n+1) owners remain distinct under a retained outer relation.

conclusions: C1 q_(n+1) is well-defined under hierarchical isomorphism.
C2 inherited actions transport through q_(n+1) with Counter multiplicity preserved.
C3 outer relation-add guard and successor are q_(n+1)-visible and Counter-multiplicity preserving.
C4 there exists c'_(n+1) with B_f(A_(n+1) x q_(n+1)) o c_(n+1) = c'_(n+1) o q_(n+1).
C5 on a transition-closed frozen carrier, equal q_(n+1) states have identical finite labelled Counter future trees.
C6 pairwise reservation accounting, grade, parity/Euler/resource laws lift.
C7 ordinary one-cross same-level composition remains at level n+1.
C8 a new level begins only when complete H_(n+1) owners remain distinct under a retained outer relation.
C9 erasing owner grouping is not sound in general.
C10 the recurrence is stratified self-similarity, not a type fixed point.
nonclaims: existence of a generated carrier at every level
persistence of H1-H13 at every level
geometry, dimension, physical time, propagation, actualisation, or cosmology
